generation.source: Root task generation result and recorded exact prompt

improvements: Paired side views allow better appendage-side comparison.
Body-under-bell proposal exposes the intended continuous quadruped torso.
Separate shell, mount bands and saddle pads expose assembly intent.
Paw/contact and head panels provide more targeted construction information.

defects.observation: Front and underside paw insets show three toes; the agreed construction proposal requires four. Full-body feet also vary in apparent count.
defects.next_correction: Author one explicit four-toe front/underside paw construction drawing, then derive mirrored left/right and front/hind drawings from it rather than regenerating an entire sheet.

defects.observation: The clapper callout points below an exterior miniature hanging bell rather than defining the main dorsal bell internal clapper.
defects.next_correction: Author a labeled longitudinal main-bell section showing crown suspension, internal rod/weight, shell, saddle, body clearance and bounded swing. Treat the separate front pendant bells as separate optional parts.

defects.observation: The body occupies the dorsal bell opening region; no section establishes a collision-free internal clapper cavity.
defects.next_correction: Resolve bell/mount/body cavity and swing envelope in a construction section before approving the internal clapper or committing geometry.

defects.observation: Paired panels remain generated illustrations. Their perspective, pose, scale and source camera are not measured or certified orthographic.
defects.next_correction: Use consistent construction landmarks and explicit declared drawing projection; do not use generated panel labels as calibration evidence.

method_decision: Stop broad full-sheet image-generation retries for these defects. Use bounded manually authored 2D construction drawings with explicit part labels and shared views; review the corrected packet before complex modeling.
next_action: Complete the local construction corrections described in CONSTRUCTION_CORRECTIONS.md, then reassess formal-reference readiness. Do not request owner approval of the known-bad packet.
